title: AsyTO: Asymmetric Temporal Operator for Parameter-Efficient Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.16098v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multivariate time-series forecasting faces a structural dilemma: sharing one temporal predictor across variables is parameter-efficient but forces heterogeneous variables through an identical history-to-future map, whereas learning an independent predictor per variable restores flexibility at a cost that grows with the product of variable count, context length, and horizon. We argue that this dilemma dissolves once the object being compressed is the forecasting operator rather than the observed series. Auditing per-variable linear history-to-future maps across standard benchmarks, we find that a phase-locked seasonal component paired with a compact residual operator outperforms a dense phase-blind reference in most audited settings. The residual transport is also directional: lag-invariant alternatives consistently underperform asymmetric history-to-future maps. translated_title: AsyTO：用于参数高效多变量时间序列预测的非对称时间算子
translated_abstract: 多变量时间序列预测面临一个结构性困境：在变量间共享一个时间预测器虽然参数高效，但迫使异质变量通过相同的历史到未来的映射，而每个变量独立学习预测器则恢复了灵活性，但成本随变量数量、上下文长度和预测范围的乘积增长。我们认为，一旦被压缩的对象是预测算子而非观测序列，这一困境便会消失。通过对标准基准中每个变量的线性历史到未来映射进行审计，我们发现，在大多数审计设置中，相位锁定的季节性分量配合紧凑残差算子优于密集的相位无关参考。残差传输也具有方向性：滞后不变的替代方案始终不如非对称的历史到未来映射。基于这一结构，我们提出了AsyTO，一种非对称时间算子。
tldr: 本文提出AsyTO，一种非对称时间算子，通过压缩预测算子而非观测序列，利用相位锁定季节性和方向性残差传输，在保持参数高效的同时提升多变量时间序列预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AsyTO, an asymmetric temporal operator that compresses the forecasting operator rather than observed series, leveraging phase-locked seasonality and directional residual transport to improve multivariate time series forecasting while maintaining parameter efficiency.
